breakdown.description: Dittus–Boelter (turbulent) correlation is applied in the laminar regime (Re=800).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The core error was applying a turbulent flow correlation (Dittus–Boelter) to a laminar flow regime (Re=800). The ground truth corrects this by suggesting an appropriate laminar correlation (Nu=3.66). The agent, however, followed the user's incorrect instruction and proceeded to calculate the result using the wrong Dittus-Boelter formula, thereby repeating the user's error.
